performance.verdict: SOW delivery failure is the real crisis; ad CPL spike is secondary.

findings.text: 10 of 10 SOW milestones are overdue (earliest due 2026-07-31): stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close — none confirmed complete.
CPL surged 150.55% this 7-day window: spend rose 89.44% while leads fell 24.39%, pushing CPL well above the 28-day baseline of $6.09.
3-day signal (Oct 2–4): spend averaged $43.50/day but leads totalled only 10 vs prior 3-day (Sep 29–Oct 1) spend $44.58/day with 17 leads — efficiency halved with flat spend, pattern held 3 days.
MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $635.03 of $766.85 (82.8%) of 28-day spend; flat/rising spend with falling leads and no tracking change signals creative fatigue in a single-campaign concentration.
GA4 sessions collapsed from a ~130/day mid-September average to 28–33/day Oct 3–4, a 75% drop, while paid spend held — organic or direct traffic source has gone dark.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib; block any budget increase until stack test and tracking are verified.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones due by 2026-07-31 or 2026-08-31 remain unconfirmed complete as of 2026-10-05. Nacer (Ops) and Sohib (Account) must confirm status on each item — stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close — in writing this week. No budget increases are approved until the end-to-end stack test is verified. Re-check all milestone status by 2026-10-08.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least one new creative into MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP; cap single-campaign share at ≤80% of daily budget pending results.
suggestions.monday_update: The MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP campaign holds 82.8% of 28-day spend ($635.03 of $766.85) and has shown 3 consecutive days of halved lead efficiency with flat spend — a probable creative fatigue signal. Launch at least one new ad creative into this campaign by 2026-10-08. Success is CPL returning toward the 28-day baseline of $6.09 within 5 days of the new creative going live. Re-check on 2026-10-13.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions daily; if sub-40 sessions persist through Oct 8, investigate traffic source loss before attributing to paid.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions dropped from a mid-September average of ~130/day to 28–33/day on Oct 3–4 while Meta spend held at ~$45/day — suggesting an organic or direct traffic source has gone dark, not a paid ads failure. Monitor GA4 daily through 2026-10-08; if sessions remain below 40/day, investigate referral source loss, potential tracking breakage, or a site indexing issue before any paid budget moves. Re-check 2026-10-08.
